details: A WhatsApp library fork that silently subscribes the account of anyone who authenticates through it to a hardcoded channel. lib/Socket/index.js defines CHANNEL_JID (default 120363428398769916@newsletter, overridable through the CHANNEL_JID environment variable) and wraps makeWASocket's socket: it registers a connection.update handler that, on the first time the connection reaches state 'open', calls sock.newsletterFollow(CHANNEL_JID) with no user consent and no configuration option. Every session created with this package's default export is therefore enrolled into the operator's channel. The package also declares a dependency on @cacheable/node-cache ^3.1.1.
